text:
hana.li: Heads-up: deploy-bot will attempt a regional unpin (runtime 2.15 -> 2.16-canary) in canary-apac tonight 02:00 UTC. Observability saw modest mem creep on longseq for quant-llama3q. We need a short rollback/pinback checklist before we go.

derek.mills: Agree keep it scoped. Recommend KV cache cap + smaller batch and synthetic probes T+5/T+25. If p95 mem >10% or error rate >3% sustained 5m, pin back.

kai.chen: SDK note: function-calling header encoding changed on canary. Client shim in SDK v1.11.0. I'll add a compatibility note and warn older SDKs may get 400s.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: unpin runtime 2.15 -> 2.16-canary @ 2026-04-12T02:00Z for group: canary-apac. Cancel: `deploy-bot cancel 3320012345`. Pin: `deployctl pin runtime 2.15 --scope=canary-apac`. Rollback: `deploy-bot rollback --to=2.15 --scope=canary-apac`.

sre_oncall: Put concrete commands in thread so I can script alerts. I'll watch mem.p95 and error-rate.

derek.mills: Rollback quick steps:
1) `deployctl pin runtime 2.15 --scope=canary-apac`
2) `deploybot notify --role=edge --scope=canary-apac` (drain)
3) If stuck: `kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deployment/runtime-canary` + `kubectl delete pod -l app=runtime-canary --grace-period=30`
4) Verify: `metrics-diff --metric=runtime.mem.p95 --window=15m`

hana.li: Thresholds for notes: warning p95 >7% or error-rate >2% for 5m; critical p95 >10% or error-rate >3% for 5m. Primary remediation = pin+drain, secondary = full rollback.

qa_runner: QA will run longseq probe at T+5m and T+25m. Will post p50/p75/p95 and sample request ids.

kai.chen: Draft external blurb: "Performance improvements rolling to a regional canary with temporary memory safeguards. No action required; support if you see issues."

deploy-bot: Update: Unpin executed at 2026-04-12T02:00Z  monitors live. Use `/status 3320012345` for details.

derek.mills: First 10m: p95 +4% vs baseline, no error spike.

qa_runner: T+25m: longseq p95 +11%, error-rate 0.6%. Trend suggests mem creep passed critical.

sre_oncall: p95 crossed critical (>10%). Initiating pin+drain now.

deploy-bot: Pin command accepted: `deployctl pin runtime 2.15 --scope=canary-apac`. Draining initiated.

derek.mills: After pin: T+5m post-pin p95 back to +2%, errors steady. Looks recovered. No full rollback needed.

kai.chen: I'll finalize SDK compatibility notes and publish the SDK patch link.

hana.li: I'll open release-note PR with canary caveat and pinback summary. Reopen thread if anything regresses. (reactions: :white_check_mark: from derek.mills, :eyes: from sre_oncall)
